input: # Commentary, PGN spec 5. A comment attaches to the move it follows; one
# that follows no move annotates the starting position of its line.
# The body is kept verbatim, whitespace included.
# 5: a brace comment may span lines, and does not nest — the first `}` ends
# it, and a `{` or `;` inside loses its meaning.
# Braces inside a rest-of-line comment lose their meaning (5).
# --- [%name arg,arg] markup: a de facto extension, on by default ---
# Switched off, the same comment is text and nothing more.
# A bracket that is not command markup stays plain text.
